But when it starts to take effect, Manel confesses to something much more unexpected: that he's a member of an ETA commando.

films.t: Captain Sabertooth and the Countess of Grel
films.syn: Raven and Pinky are two inseparable friends who sail under the orders of the feared Captain Sabretooth, the king of the seven seas. But their friendship will be put to the test when the cunning Sibylla, Countess of Grel, attacks the pirate ship, steals the valuable figurehead and kidnaps Pinky.

films.t: Chicho o mientras el cuerpo aguante (una comedia didáctica)
films.syn: Non-fiction film about the life of the singer-songwriter and philosopher Chicho Sánchez Ferlosio, son of the phalangist writer Rafael Sánchez Mazas and brother of the author Rafael Sánchez Ferlosio. The film portrays the everyday existence and reflections of an unrepeatable songsmith, by then distanced from political and social life, and of the filming apparatus itself, with Fernando Trueba directing his second feature. An approach to the life of Chicho and his partner Rosa through his resistance songs.

Cine vivo is a short film, this performance, a book. An artifact that mutates according to its own narrative and spatial needs. It shapes itself, borrowing elements from the different disciplines, but in its name too it recognises the process of decomposition of the material that makes life to continue existing and latch onto another organism. The condition of death as an inexorable part of life. All the impurity of writing combined with the impurity of film to shape this new vital cyber organism. An artifact coming from the past to be launched into the future like a capsule of possibilities. A philosophy, a moral and an eroticism drawing on stories, on praxis, on death, on omissions, on processes, on the nobility of banality, as Marguerite Duras would say, on chemicals and time. That unavoidable gem, that unfathomable condition on which both the cinema and life itself feed.

Peter, a hard-partying New York City club promoter accustomed to a life of excess, electronic music and endless nights, sees his whirlwind lifestyle upended when a woman he doesn't know shows up on his doorstep with Arlo, a 10-year-old boy she claims is his son. What started out as an impossible situation soon turns into a mad, fun and tender connection, as unexpected as it is transformative.

Surrounded by brutality but bound by tenderness, two World War I soldiers find a fragile sanctuary of love and art amid the shadows of the Belgian trenches. Lukas Dhont’s Coward asks a profound question for a generation sent to war: when the world demands violence, is walking away the truest act of bravery?

films.t: Cuelgamuros, Between the Difficult and the Impossible
films.ot: Cuelgamuros, entre lo difícil y lo imposible
films.syn: For the first time a recording is made of the Cuelgamuros crypts, hidden behind the walls of the basilica chancels. There, more than 33,800 people are buried in Spain's biggest mass grave. We enter with the forensic team who, since 2023, have been trying to locate and identify 214 of them. We will discover surprising findings and hear the harsh criticism, denunciations and bureaucracy facing them after taking on a historical challenge that they themselves believed to be impossible.

ap.sel: Officially selected (Youth, cinema, memory and democracy - 50 years of freedom)

films.syn: Troubled by forbidden feelings for his seven-year-old stepdaughter, Richard decides to leave his girlfriend. He retreats to his childhood home to renovate ahead of its sale, but his self-imposed exile is disrupted by the childlike presence of his mother's caregiver, Stella. He soon discovers her double life as a Lolita camgirl, and the two develop a transgressive surrogate father-daughter relationship. Their constructed reality begins to unravel when the stepdaughter he left behind reaches out.

On opposite sides of the world, communities separated by thousands of kilometres share the same way of living with the sea. From the legendary women divers of Jeju island, the haenyeo, to professions such as net-making or the rowing of boats by women on the Basque coast, the documentary builds a sociocultural bridge between territories which may seem different, but which are in fact deeply connected by common values, pace of life and their relationship with the natural environment.

films.ot: Zza szyby podglądam, jak umiera sarna, młoda
films.syn: Across the morning landscape drifts the sound of an axe. White ribbons that only yesterday danced in the wind now stand still in silence. Helka, yesterday's bride, bids farewell to her family home and walks through the village toward her husband's house. She carries a quilt filled with goose feathers once plucked by her mother. On her journey into adulthood, the music of the rural world becomes Helka's sole companion.

films.t: El abrazo de los peces (15 años después)
films.syn: Can a fish learn to hug? Why are deafblind people happy underwater? El abrazo de los p eces / The Embrace of the Fish is a sensory journey into the depths of deafblindness. The Santa Ángela de la Cruz Centre is the only residential centre for deafblind people existing in Spain, and one of the few in the world. There, on that bubble planet, live Juande, Victoria, Cristian, Clara, Jose Luis... whose singular feature is that they are deafblind people.

Following the death of the official poet of the Francoist regime, Leopoldo Panero, his widow (Felicidad Blanc) and his three sons (Juan Luis, Leopoldo María and Michi) meet to remember his figure. Shot in the final stages of the Franco era, the film became an unwitting metaphor of a country that was starting to air its secrets and into an emblem of the Spanish Transition.
After years of estrangement, the famous writer and academic Santiago Balmes gathers his three children for a last request: to spend Christmas in the house where they used to spend summers as kids. ​

In 1995 Chiquito de la Calzada was an indisputable idol. His humour and language caught on in Spanish society, causing furor in an entire generation. One night, Spain's most popular TV show presented Lucas Grijander, a disturbingly similar character. This was the start of a nightmare for Gregorio Esteban who felt that his identity had been usurped, giving rise to an unusual dispute: Chiquito vs Lucas Grijander. A struggle for ownership of a cultural phenomenon and for one man's survival.

A young man tells a journalist about the photos and memories from his childhood in his home and village that will soon disappear to make way for his country's new capital city. With his brother, he returns to the places where they played as children, taking pictures and recreating their stories as if the land was still the same.

aw: Tabakalera Film and Audiovisual Laboratory-Nest Award

films.syn: Freeing himself after spending a hundred years trapped in a glacier, the ghost of the filmmaker Lucien Castelnau wanders through a futuristic Patagonia, where technological progress clashes with forgotten stories. Unable to rest while his cinematic legacy remains unseen, he crosses a world that has deleted him from its memory, in search of a place in history and of spectators, who can finally bring his lost work back to life.

Why is Getaria is the best place in the world to eat fish? Driven by that question, an anthropologist heads for the coastal town. She makes her way down to the quay every day to record the life of the place, even if it means getting up at 3:30 in the morning. Phone in hand, she will film every secret she comes across; however, with time, she will no longer be a simple onlooker but will become a part of that singular community.

aw: Eusko Label Award - Eusko Label First Award

films.syn: A divorced father, eager to spend a weekend with his children, suddenly finds himself in a hostile confrontation with his ex-wife. His hopes of reconciliation turn to mistrust, anger and personal revelations, with the children as innocent bystanders.

A director returns to his childhood home to recreate, with actors, the argument that drove his parents apart when he was four years old. Through improvisation and a film shoot that reveals his own artifice, he builds memories to which he never had access. But as the scene repeats itself, the indications lose their clarity and the border between reconstruction and desire start to blur.

Adela, a Mexican sound artist, travels from the jungle to the Peruvian Andes with Lucho, her guide and translator. Following in the footsteps of her grandfather, a Catalan republican exiled in Mexico, she weaves a sound map of endangered languages. When the fear of death appears, the reality breaks into pieces. Adela’s journey becomes an intimate voyage to her childhood home. Lejos de los árboles / Far from the Trees is packed with tales of the fragility of existence and the need to remember, listen and love.

ap.sel: Officially selected (Zabaltegi-Tabakalera - Ikusmira Berriak 2022, Proyecta 2021, 50 years of freedom)

films.syn: Fatherland centres on the relationship between the Nobel Prize-winning writer Thomas Mann and his daughter Erika - actress, writer and rally driver. In the summer of 1949, at the height of the Cold War, father and daughter embark on a challenging and emotional road trip in a black Buick taking them across a Germany in ruins - from US dominated Frankfurt to Soviet controlled Weimar. Returning home after sixteen years of exile in the US, Thomas Mann has to face not only a divided fatherland, but also a deep fracture within his own family.
Two different notions of family identity clash when a man from Odesa and his son visit his brother in Germany for the funeral of their mother, the day before the Ukraine war breaks out.

Martha, a mother who lost trace of her son in the Colombian armed conflict, receives the news that no bone match was found in the last exhumation in which she had taken part. Having exhausted the institutional options, she turns to a group of women, where she meets Sandra, who tells her a rumour: "in a remote village in the plains, you can ask a dead person for a favour". The two set out on a journey in search of answers.

The Gheorghius, a devout Romanian Norwegian couple, settle in a village in a remote fjord where they strike up a close relationship with their neighbours, the Halbergs. Their children bond despite the differences in their education. When the teenage Elia Gheorghiu turns up at school with bruises on her body, the community asks itself if the traditional education the children receive from their parents might have anything to do with it.

Using archive material and employing a fragmented, polyphonic structure, the film presents a history of flamenco that links it to modernity, popular culture and politics. Through unexpected narratives and associations, and featuring figures from various eras and contexts, the film explores an impure flamenco that is in constant dialogue with the world, where tradition, mass culture, and the contemporary imagination coexist.
An accident leaves 11-year-old Thomas unable to walk. With Fleak, a creature from another dimension, he discovers a surreal world where he must confront the monster born from his own shadow.

Ever since Olga’s terrible loss, she has preferred to keep to herself, but having no money to pay for an operation on her big toe obliges her to rent a room in her flat to Tulio, the husband of a patient hospitalised in the medical centre in front of the enormous apartment block in which Olga lives. When the man has to leave for a few days, he leaves his son Christian in his place.​

aw: Horizontes MAKE & MARK Award - Special Mention

films.syn: Jamal, who has a diagnosis of schizophrenia, lives in a supported housing block, alongside other people with mental health issues. Frustrated by the side effects of his medication, he stops taking it, making the voices he hears become more frequent and extreme. Increasingly changeable in mood, Jamal builds a friendship with Kyla, another resident. But as the voices become more intense, Jamal must confront the blurred line between reality, and past family events, to come to terms with his voices.
In the tough neighbourhood of Tepito, a young boy chases the great Mexican dream: to become a boxing champion.

After years studying in Europe, Elsa returns to Costa Rica to reunite with her family. She finds her younger sister living alone in the family home, growing increasingly distant and reclusive, as if slipping into a world of her own. Their parents, meanwhile, are absorbed in their own lives. Her father drifts through a series of affairs, while her mother is immersed in republishing the erotic poems of her youth, neither fully grasping the urgency of the situation.

films.t: From the Orchard to the Plate
films.syn: A gastronomic journey following fresh produce from the garden to the table, showcasing the care, the passion and the work that goes into transforming the land into a unique culinary experience.

After a career spanning 25 years, the rock group Gatibu bids farewell to the stage having produced the soundtrack for a whole generation. The documentary accompanies its members on this last tour, capturing key moments and intimate landscapes packed with emotion. More than the chronicle of a band on the road, the film reflects on the passing of time, personal and collective transformation, maturity and the importance of knowing how to say goodbye.

Farasha and Faris are 20 when they meet at a graduation party – one glance that changes everything. But Farasha dies that very same night. Refusing to be separated from him, she discovers a way to cross the boundary between worlds: for 40 nights, and 40 nights only, she can meet Faris in his dreams. And so their love continues to grow, until the very last night.

ap.sel: Officially selected (Official Selection - Opening Film (In competition))

films.syn: 18-year-old Gislaine claims to have had a dream in which she was visited by a divine voice promising her an extraordinary future filled with fame and money. Some time later, on her graduation day, she still clings to that promise, harbouring a hope she doesn't dare to pronounce in the face of the demands of ambition and direction.

Chivilcoy, 1957. In a quiet Argentinian town, the arrival of an ominous former police commissioner and his seductive wife fractures the bond between four inseparable young men. Decades later, the past resurfaces, forcing them to confront old wounds, guilt, and the possibility of revenge in a country which has lost its innocence.

It’s summer harvest on a vegetable farm in northern Germany. The daily routine of seasonal worker Frida and her international colleagues is shaped by fixed rhythms and repetitive tasks. As the end of the season approaches an uncertainty about what comes next begins to grow. Yet when a bird gets trapped in the greenhouses, time seems to stand still for a moment.

Although born as a film for television, Go!azen enters its thirteenth season this year. The first musical series produced in the Basque Country returns yet again to the Basakabi summer camp with new adventures, bringing covers of Basque songs old and new. Yet another season packed with fun and escapades.

A stranger appears over the mountain, carrying little more than his determination. Isak, a man without a past, seeks a place to settle and carve life from the earth. High above the tree line, he finds a barren stretch of land, as unforgiving as it is full of promise. The land tests him to his limits, until he meets Inger, a solitary woman shaped by resilience and quiet secrecy. Together, they endure the elements and build a life, cultivating both the soil and a growing family as the seasons turn. Yet as years pass and the world closes in, and time, hardship, and desire reshape them.

aw: Silver Shell for Best Leading Performance (ex aequo) (Asta Kamma August)
Jury Prize for Best Cinematography (Oskar Dahlsbakken)

films.syn: “Night will fall fourteen times in this film. We will count them.” So begins this nocturnal, musical journey—a voyage that drifts through the artistic vision of the Basque artist Jorge Oteiza, and which is dominated, above all, by an “Interior, Night” setting: the Basilica of Arantzazu. It is there that the longest night unfolds, beside the sanctuary’s organ, where filmmaker Oskar Alegria shuts himself away to recount these fourteen nights to pianist Iñar Sastre—summoning him to conjure, through the keys, images he wont see. From this challenge emerges a collection of fourteen moons, fourteen darknesses, and fourteen mysteries that form a single frieze. Fourteen, like the number of apostles Oteiza managed to place on the façade of that temple in an artistic challenge that broke all the rules; and fourteen because, as he himself put it, “there was no room for any more.”

Hands are essential for making high quality produce, like Idiazabal cheese. Adult hands do the work today that will be done tomorrow by hands that are as yet small, childlike. These hands care for sheep, milk them, prepare the curd, fashion the end product and mature it in the proper places. The cheese, once made, passes from the hands of adults to those of children, demonstrating how that work comes from yesterday and will continue tomorrow.

aw: Eusko Label Award - Eusko Label Second Award

films.syn: A poetic-graphic-visual piece inviting us to stop and concentrate on the basics: the emotion, the matter, the care, the quality, the love, and the interdependence that shapes who we are-what we eat, between sustainability and sensitivity towards the/our territory-landscape.
Chemotherapy leaves Candela feeling undesirable and unseen. To brave love again, she must confront her shame and reclaim her femininity.

After a harrowing plane crash, Special Forces officer James Belmont and his combat dog, Odin, find themselves stranded deep in the Alaskan wilderness. Together, they are forced into a brutal fight for survival against the elements. From acclaimed filmmaker David Ayer, Heart of the Beast is an intense adventure thriller that explores the unbreakable bond between a man and his best friend as they face their greatest battle yet.

ap.sel: Officially selected (Official Selection - Not in competition)

films.syn: At the height of the Tafalla fiestas, Julián (62) and Pepa (64) search for the lost keys that are preventing them from arriving in time to a spa gifted to them by their son. What starts out as a minor inconvenience turns into an intimate journey.
A young female intern at a small magazine company and a drug-addicted lesbian photographer slowly fall in love while exploiting each other to get ahead in their respective careers.

Not altogether happy with Jean Becker's version of his novel L'Excommunié in Un nommé La Rocca , Giovanni personally set about adapting the work, in colour by now, but with the same actor, Jean-Paul Belmondo. The film lends greater detail than its predecessor to the life of organised crime in the Marseilles of the 30s, prior to the character ending up in jail and returning to civilian life after a series of adventures.

One of the few cases in which Giovanni would not participate in writing the script adapting one of his novels. Jean-Paul Belmondo plays a former racing car driver. He has stopped racing since one of his friends died in an accident and now drives the getaway car for small-time gang of criminals. Gradually the idea of a solo heist takes shape in his mind.

Tokiko's husband has passed away and she lives alone in her big house. She yearns for social connection and starts job hunting, but her age and past are insurmountable barriers. Then she meets Ain, a Vietnamese youth working at the local supermarket, and an awkward friendship develops between them.Tokiko gets up her hopes about Ain's place in her life. When their relationship unravels, Tokiko makes a fateful decision.

films.t: Homeland of the Ice Cream Sellers
films.syn: "I met Xavier by chance, while travelling together. That encounter opened the door to a largely unknown European memory: the epic of the 'pasiegos', who went on to become one of the most influential communities in the world of French ice-cream. From Cantabria's Pasiego valleys, where life revolved around cattle and milk, thousands of men and women set out on a journey in the quest for an uncertain future, putting their fate in the hands of destiny. Some built huge empires and went as far as to sponsor the Tour de France; others left a legacy of such value that it enabled their children to enjoy a better life. Through Xavier, and as his father comes to the end of his life, I set out on a journey to find the memory of those families. A journey ending with the return of hundreds of descendants to the land of their ancestors, where for the first time in more than a century, the families of ice-cream makers will meet as never before, in search of a shared homeland". (Maite Vitoria Daneris)

ap.sel: Officially selected (Made in Spain - 50 years of freedom)

films.syn: Reinforcements have been diverted to battle wildfires and all communication has been cut off. Hope Harbor's police outpost chief Bum-seok and officer Sung-ae struggle to defend a village of the elderly, while in the mountains, Sung-ki and the locals who set out to track the beast find themselves hunted instead. What begins as ignorance plants the seed of disaster, escalating through human conflict into a tragedy of cosmic proportions.

films.t: If someone wants to flirt with me, they have to take me out to eat
films.ot: Si alguien quiere ligar conmigo, que me invite a comer bien
films.syn: Kepa always joked that the best way to win him over was to invite him for a good meal. When he meets Peio, their homemade dinners turn into a habit that will bring them increasingly closer to one another. Between recipes, conversations and shared moments, the two discover that their relationship is more than a simple friendship.

Satomi works at an art museum until an envelope arrives, containing a mysterious key. It leads to an unknown room once belonging to her late father, who died alone a month earlier. Drawn by this small object, she retraces his final days: a man seemingly left behind by society, yet sustained by a quiet devotion to words, the art of tea, and subtle beauty. Through the traces of his solitude, Satomi slowly discovers the quiet grace of the world he inhabited.

An explosive cinematic rollercoaster about a group of visionaries and misfits who had an idea for a new kind of news — one that would give the people what they want and would change the face of the world we live in today.

The story follows Andrzej, a young doctor with a passion for jazz, a somewhat cynical persona with a carefree lifestyle. One night he meets a mysterious young woman called Pelagia with whom he spends the night playing a game of seduction full of masks, irony and mistrust. For a few hours, their relationship evolves between attraction and detachment, revealing the difficulty of establishing real ties in an environment marked by emotional uncertainty.

Iron Boy tells the tale of Christophe, an 11-year-old boy who tries to follow in his father's steps, helping in their family farm. But everything changes the day he is prescribed an incapacitating iron corset, meaning that he can no longer do the everyday farm chores. However, this sudden change will give Christophe the opportunity to discover new passions like swimming and music, and to make friends who will forever mark his life.

Matteo is playing tennis when a woman in a bride's dress runs onto the court. It's Greta. She kicks off her shoes, grabs a racket and invites him to play. For seven years, the woman will never be far from Matteo's mind. As they follow their paths and parallel lives, fate seems determined to keep them apart. But one day they run into each other again and now, perhaps, their time has come. Will it happen tonight?

In a greenhouse in southern Spain, Iván falls in love with his newly hired co-worker, Hadoum. But his long-awaited promotion interferes with their relationship, forcing Iván to decide what kind of person he wants to be.

ap.sel: Officially selected (Made in Spain - 50 years of freedom)

films.syn: Izarrak explores the route that has led Basque gastronomy and the area of San Sebastián to become a unique global benchmark. From the seafaring expeditions that would set sail from Pasaia 500 years ago in search of fortune and spice to the revolution of Basque Nouvelle Cuisine, the documentary intertwines identity and territory with the stories of those who come today to Gipuzkoa in search of a future and of those who work on the sea and land to preserve a tradition with its eyes set on tomorrow.

After accidentally witnessing a rape in San Francisco's Golden Gate Park, 8-year-old Josephine starts to demonstrate violent and paranoid behaviour. The trauma destabilises her family as her parents seek justice and a way to recover her lost security.

1985, Vincent, almost 13, lives in the suburbs of Paris with his middle-class family, caught between an older brother who brushes him off and parents who never stop arguing. No longer a kid but not yet an adult, Vincent fumbles through life's big questions: identity, friendship, family, first crushes... and why adults never seem to have figured things out either.

ap.sel: Officially selected (Perlak - Closing film out of competition)

films.syn: This is the story of Sandra Sánchez, a woman who defied all conventions to become the best female karateka ever to have existed. With the guidance of Jesús del Moral, her trainer and life companion, Sandra set out on an impossible journey: to win an Olympic gold medal at the age of 39 in a sport dominated by the Japanese and where the oldest retire at the age of 30. A tale of love, greatness and struggle that goes way beyond karate and grows into a legend.

films.t: Kotodama, The Way of the Mirror
films.syn: lnari sets out on a journey to discover the meaning of Kotodama , delving into Japanese art and calligraphy, while following the routes of the Camino de Santiago, in Spain, and the Shikoku Henro, in Japan. On his way, the action of walking and the calligraphic line reveal themselves to be the expressions of a same idea: the way as a process. Pilgrims, monks, artisans and calligraphers become the voices of a universal history, creating a bridge between the past and the present, East and West.

Inspired by true events, Krux tells the dark story of a small northeastern German village at the end of WWII, when the Nazi regime gave its citizens the order to leave nothing alive for the enemy to find. Most of the men are at the front. What remains is a handful of women, children, and the few men who were allowed to stay behind. Life still runs on its old rituals: school, church, weddings, work. The villagers still believe it will end well. Then the river gives up bodies no one can name. No one knows when the enemy will come, or what will happen when they do. Rumors fill the silence where facts should be. Out of that silence grows a fear larger than the enemy itself.

After the death of her estranged father, Angelica and her brother are forced to return to their childhood home: a big house in the French countryside overflowing with unspeakable clutter and the lingering presence of their despotic parent. As Angelica begins the overwhelming task of clearing it out, she comes across her teenage diaries, resurrecting a secret and fierce love she once harbored for her history teacher, Mademoiselle B.

Story narrating the interconnected stories of three men in three different eras. Three lives intimately linked by sexuality and desire, pain and inheritence. This is one of Federico García Lorca’s last, unfinished, works.

Lluís Garau, a young dancer, creates a performance inspired by a platform that randomly connects strangers through video calls. But when his online life and his real life begin to intertwine, the boundaries between the virtual and the tangible blur, leaving an irreversible mark on his final work: La carn .

On a remote, wind-lashed island off the Chilean coast, Silvia earns her living harvesting seaweed and shares a quiet life with her partner. When she adopts a stray puppy, Yuri, her days fill with joy, love, and a tenderness that stirs a long-suppressed longing for motherhood. But Yuri’s sudden disappearance reawakens a haunting childhood trauma, forcing Silvia to confront a past she has never truly left behind.

Lino Ventura plays a hardened cop who is ousted from his position when he arrests an influential lawyer's drunk-driving son. His new stomping ground is a suburban police station where he is initially assigned to rooting out sexual perverts. Teamed up with a rookie partner (Marlène Jobert, Eva Green's mother), the two are tasked with the mission of finding a protected witness with the only clue of his last known address.

1943. The Nazis occupy Belgium and have turned the national daily Le Soir into their propaganda tool. With 1918 Armistice Day commemorations forbidden, a group of Resistance fighters comes up with a wild idea: what if, to lift the spirits of the Belgian people, they could print a fake edition of Le Soir ? Same paper, same nameplate, same format, but packed with articles mocking the occupier. A true story. A fake newspaper. The world's first media hack.

ap.sel: Officially selected (Official Selection - Closing film out of competition, 50 years of freedom)

films.syn: Midway between adventure and espionage, the film opens with the kidnapping of a high-ranking NATO general by a terrorist group. The French secret services therefore recruit an unruly bunch of individuals and train them to become the commando who will free the general. The shoot was complicated, but very much to Giovanni's liking, with underwater scenes and others showing the breathtaking climbing of vertical cliffs.

After enduring 19 years in prison for stealing a loaf of bread, Jean Valjean emerges a hardened man. He seeks redemption by reinventing himself as a respected dignitary under a new identity. He promises Fantine, a dying factory worker, to rescue and protect her daughter Cosette, who is being exploited and mistreated by the deceitful Thénardier family. As Valjean raises Cosette as his own, he is relentlessly pursued by Inspector Javert. Amidst the social unrest shaking France, the fates of Valjean, Cosette, her lover Marius, and Javert become intertwined in a turbulent, revolutionary Paris. Through struggles, sacrifices, and a deep yearning for justice, Valjean strives to complete his journey of redemption and offer Cosette a future of love and freedom.

Adaptation of the autobiographical novel by Albert Spaggiari, who masterminded one of the biggest bank robberies committed until then. One day in July 1976, Spaggiari and his sidekicks tunnelled through the sewers until breaking into the vault of the Société Général Bank in Nice, where they stayed for a whole weekend and stole 60 million francs, plus bonds and valuables. It was called the robbery of the century.

In 2026, the Verdi Cinemas, Barcelona's oldest working cinema, will celebrate their centenary. With humour and through the eyes of two young girls, the film explores the history of the cinema and the people who have brought it to life. It paints a portrait of a cinema whose influence extends throughout Gràcia, the city of Barcelona, ​​and several generations of movie-lovers. The Verdi is, today as it was then, a place of meeting and passion for cinema.

The murder of poet Federico García Lorca in 1936 turned him into a global myth. For 90 years a name, a forbidden relationship and a plan of escape to Mexico have been kept under wraps. This film is the tragedy of a last love cut short by fascism, between Lorca and a young man called Juan Ramírez de Lucas. Constructed with unseen documents: letters, poems and souvenirs. Juan left a message saying that, after his death, everything should be known.

ap.sel: Officially selected (RTVE Galas - 50 years of freedom)

films.syn: Iman has built his life in Berlin around absence. From his family, from Iran, from being known. He fills the silence with work, invented stories, and nights with a man he meets for sex in the park. When his cousin, whom he barely knows, arrives from Tehran for a brief visit, what he left behind quietly finds its way back to him.

Eva visits her mother María, who has Alzheimer’s. By asking her questions, Eva prompts childhood memories in her mother, who confuses the past with the present. During a stroll around the home, a moment of lucidity moves Eva.

Cooking has never been a neutral gesture. We head for the cooker when we're hungry, but not only to satisfy our appetite: there's always something else behind the excercise. When we think of a recipe, we do it from a certain place, adding what we are, what we've been taught, and when we make it, we do it with respect for a series of rituals that we've seen repeated over the years.

To save his job at the zoo, David agrees to a risky mission in South America: to bring back a mysterious package. The assignment sees him embark on a cruise ship with his ex, their son, and his clumsy colleague Stéphane. Things get completely out of hand when the box opens.

The Mallard family leads a monotonous and uneventful life. The father, Mack, is content with keeping his family safe and splashing in a New England pond. However, the mother, Pam, yearns for a change and wishes to show the whole world to her young son, Dax, and her duckling daughter, Gwen. After a migrating flock of ducks flies to the Mallards' pond with exciting stories from faraway places, Pam convinces Mack to embark on a family trip that passes through New York and arrives in tropical Jamaica.

Alice arrives in a quiet provincial town and takes a job at a local café, blending easily into a life that isn't hers. Her presence is no coincidence. She is there because of Milo, a young mechanic who works at a nearby garage. To him, Alice is a stranger. To her, he is someone tied to a past she has never truly left behind. As buried tensions begin to surface and Milo drifts toward uncertain ground, both are pushed to a crossroads: is it possible to rebuild a bond that shattered decades ago?

aw: Fundación SGAE Best Original Music Award

films.syn: Russia, 2022. When Gleb, a successful company director, finds himself under siege from mounting corporate pressures and an increasingly unstable world, the collapse of his carefully ordered life accelerates toward violence.

In this video letter, the director speaks to her aunt, the victim of femicide, telling her how it has been to live and grow in her absence. Based on a performance in which she projects the last Facebook message sent to her by her aunt, the young filmmaker reconstructs her own history marked by the fear of living in a country which is dangerous for women and by the complicated situation of being the only woman in her family.

Yasuhiko Mitani runs a secretive six-seat Tokyo sushi sanctuary with a four-year waitlist, dedicated entirely to artistic purity. His philosophy, "The Mariage", pairs exquisite sushi with rare wine and sake on a molecular level. Driven by deep gratitude after surviving a severe heart condition, Mitani treats every ingredient with profound reverence. This documentary follows his ultimate challenge of bringing his unparalleled culinary art to a global stage at the Lotte New York Palace.

Mateo is a small-town vet. Since his son died, he has lived a life of silent routines and nameless guilt. The violence of the place isn’t immediately visible: it sits there, lurking, like a never-ending echo. This fragile balance is broken when Mateo has to heal Morro, the local capo’s injured dog. The animal’s everyday care leads to an unexpected bond: a relationship with neither judgement nor words, that enables Mateo to recover the meaning of life.

I admire my bread-making friends and I invent my own spells to look after and protect them, I write poems in their honour and, if they move house, I sell my books, throw my clothes in a pile, shove them into bin bags and go with them, to their neighbourhood, to their street and, if I can, to their building, so that they’ll give me bread, bread they’ve made that morning, last night, it doesn’t matter, it’s always fresh, warm even if it’s already cold. Bread. And my pals get me, I don’t freak them out.

Zhandos, a music teacher, lives in the small town of Balkhash and dreams of moving to a big city. He is loved by his students, and the school turns a blind eye to his side jobs. When a patron nostalgic for his hometown arrives, Zhandos is given the chance to leave and must decide what matters more: the art within him, or himself within art.

films.lang: Arabic; Basque; Catalan; English; French; Galician; German; Italian; Japanese; Portuguese; Spanish
films.syn: Four decades after taking to the stage for the first time, Fermín Muguruza launches into his last major tour: a collective journey to celebrate 40 years of music, engagement and cultural resistance. This music documentary captures the pulse of that voyage: concerts packed to the hilt, endless kilometres on the road, all sorts of encounters on the way and a shared energy that stretches beyond generations, from the bands Kortatu and Negu Gorriak to his current solo career.​

Ten years after Álex Angulo's death, Dodó, the daughter adopted by the actor in China, returns from Taiwan to find out who her father really was. With her secret suitcase, she travels around Bilbao and Madrid, once again meeting relatives, friends and film, theatre and television professionals. Their testimonials and the fragments of his works reconstruct the artistic and human memory of Álex, while Dodó recovers the lost connection and finds her own self.

films.ot: Mon père, il m’a sauvé la vie
films.syn: Based on his novel Il avait dans le coeur des jardins introuvables , Giovanni makes a heartfelt tribute to his father, Joe Damiani, who never blinks in the endeavour to free his son, sentenced to death for his part in a murder. The father (Bruno Cremer) will try to find evidence to prove his innocence. Giovanni bids farewell to the cinema with this journey through time to one of the most dramatic periods in his life.

Mima has grown up in the shadow of her father's absence, raised by her uncompromising mother, Boyka. When news of his death arrives and his body returns to their village, recognition becomes both duty and dilemma. As Boyka refuses to face the man she once loved, mother and daughter confront a silent past, forcing Mima to decide what it means to inherit a life she never chose.

Another of Giovanni's films with biographical overtones. It focuses on a young man who, to get out of jail during the occupation, agreed to collaborate with the Nazis. Some time later, as the war draws to an end, he will try to seek redemption by helping a French intelligence officer to unmask the citizens and police who participated harshly in the repression, including his own brother.

Ema, a recently retired doctor who can see the dead, tries to process her mother's death and her own unresolved matters. The arrival of her niece Julie and the murder of three teenagers in Piedrabuena, a suburban neighborhood marked by violence, trigger a strange phenomenon that breaks the fragile balance between the living and the dead. What had been Ema's burden until then begins to spread throughout the neighborhood: the dead start to make themselves present, and no one will be able to escape the sound of their own ghosts.

Paraguay, 1959. Under a suffocating military regime, Narciso returns from Buenos Aires with rock & roll in his veins. Charismatic, mysterious and the object of desire for both men and women, he soon becomes a radio sensation and a symbol of freedom. But after his final show he is found dead. In a country where silence reigns and fear smothers the truth… who killed Narciso?​

ap.sel: Officially selected (Horizontes Latinos - Closing Film, Europe-Latin America Co-Production Forum 2020, 50 years of freedom)

films.syn: Shot at night on the rooftops of Tel Aviv, the film reveals in detail the systems behind Israel's calculated mass killing of Palestinian civilians in Gaza.

Candela lives a monotonous life in an inland village. During the local festivities, she accidentally runs over her nephew's dog, but decides not to tell him. Instead, she invents a legend about a pilgrimage of dogs to a sacred tree and asks him to help her find it. Slowly, the lies start to take their toll.

aw: Tabakalera Film and Audiovisual Laboratory-Nest Award - Special Mention

films.syn: The documentary Noor: cocinar pasados posibles / Noor: Eating History delves into the creative universe of the restaurant Noor, where Paco Morales and Paola Gualandi reinterpret the legacy of Al-Andalus through haute-cuisine. A sensorial and cultural journey that moves between cities, artisans and memories, revealing the intimate philosophy behind a project that transcends gastronomy.
When a bus driven by her son plunges off an overpass, killing dozens, Vicentina seeks out the victims' families to apologize, only to discover the limits of forgiveness.

films.t: Ondarea. 50 Years of New Basque Cuisine
films.syn: By way of a tribute to those dinners/conversations, we unite, around a same table, members of that period such as Pedro Subijana, Tatus Fombellida and Ramón Roteta, alongside chefs who came to the soirée later, such as Elena Arzak, Hilario Arbelaitz and Martín Berasategui, with a view to sharing those experiences and constructing a story in first person, as well as testimonials such as that of Andoni Luis Aduriz. Meanwhile, a new generation of men and women chefs reinterprets some of the most iconic dishes of that New Basque Cuisine movement.

Out of action for years, a former revolutionary is forced back into action to face old enemies in an atmosphere packed with political tension, racism and military violence... Modern adaptation of Thomas Pynchon's novel Vineland (1990), on the radical movements of the 70s.

films.t: One Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest
films.syn: When Randle Patrick McMurphy gets transferred for evaluation from a prison farm to a mental institution, he assumes it will be a less restrictive environment. But the martinet Nurse Ratched runs the psychiatric ward with an iron fist, keeping her patients cowed through abuse, medication and sessions of electroconvulsive therapy. The battle of wills between the rebellious McMurphy and the inflexible Ratched soon affects all the ward's patients.

A chamber thriller adapted from a North American novel featuring in the Série Noire collection published by Gallimard. Fresh from a failed bank hold-up, and accused of a crime he didn't commit, the protagonist sets out to solve a string of problems in his recent past. The story had already been taken to the screen by Robert Siodmak in the film noir Cry of the City (1948).

Return to the ring and to the music hall for Tati who, shot at the Stockholm Cirkus for Swedish television, made a video recording of the mime acts that earned him fame across Europe. Surrounded by virtuoso artists: musicians, clowns, acrobats, in an atmosphere of joy and total freedom, Tati poses the question of the generation takeover while celebrating the colourful inventiveness of childhood.

films.t: Pedro Arrupe. I Survived the Atomic Bomb
films.ot: Pedro Arrupe. Yo viví la bomba atómica
films.syn: On 6 August 1945, the Enola Gay bomber plane carried the most lethal cargo ever made by a human being. At 8:15:17 am, the first atomic bomb was dropped on Hiroshima. The image imprinted on the collective memory is that of the nuclear mushroom seen from the sky, but not that of the burning bodies or that of the hands that tried to save them. That was the perspective of a Basque Jesuit priest, a missionary born in Bilbao: Pedro Arrupe.

The son of Alicia Eguren, and adopted by John William Cooke, Pedro Catella lived a remarkable life, touching on every crucial Latin American historical episode in the second half of the 20th century. A member of the Peronist resistance since the age of 9, a sniper in the Escambray mountains at 17, his life was stamped by a revolutionary and tragic fate, the fate of his country.

In the midst of professional and personal crisis, tired of her job as a cultural journalist, Thais convinces Alan, her husband, to give up everything and start a business. But not just any business. Thais wants to open a themed pizzería dedicated to Hollywood movies, her great passion. The concept is simple: Pizza and movies. A pizzeria where each pizza pays homage to a classic film or a movie star.

The story of two married couples —a laid-off worker and his wife and a documentary filmmaker and her husband — whose paths cross to film a documentary as they face their different lives and hidden desires.

The year 1974. Ana is a rebellious 19-year-old. Having run away one night, her father decides to hand her over to the Women’s Protection Board. She is sent from Barcelona to Madrid for internship in a reformatory run by nuns who follow a brutal disciplinary regime. There she will try to survive by seeking comfort and support in the friendship with Sole, a small-town girl with contagious vitality, and other girls in the same situation. ​

ap.sel: Officially selected (Official Selection - Special Screenings - Not in competition, 50 years of freedom)

films.syn: In 1970s Spain, Ali, a young Moroccan student, faces discrimination at university while trying to pass his math class. With the unexpected support of a classmate, he challenges the rigid norms of the dictatorship.

On the French Riviera, two gangs of kids compete in their favourite game: jumping off the red cliffs of the Mediterranean. Géo, barely five years old, discovers over the course of a summer a world where friendship blends with rivalry, and where the first stirrings of the heart become a source of tension.

When he died, Fernando Ruiz Vergara left dozens of drafts for films he was never able to make. The Andalusian filmmaker had only directed one documentary, Rocío , heartrending and fascinating, damned after its judicial censorship during the early years of democracy in Spain. Since then, his projects have lain dormant in the imagination and the desire. In Caja de resistencia we fabricate those dream projects, taking them to the cinema from the present, as a gesture of resistance.

ap.sel: Officially selected (Youth, cinema, memory and democracy - 50 years of freedom)

films.syn: Set in a small county town in Northeast China, the film follows Yu Meili, a laid-off factory worker trapped in a suffocating marriage, who clings to a folk belief that killing a rooster can end an unhappy union. Unable to go through with it, she finds her world quietly unsettled when a young girl insists that "roosters can lay eggs."

Fernando Ruiz Vergara dissects, in the censored documentary Rocío , the economic, class and power situations underlying the devotion to the Virgin of El Rocío, alienating a whole region. A historical document, recovered by the Andalusian Association of Historical Memory and Justice.

ap.sel: Officially selected (Youth, cinema, memory and democracy - 50 years of freedom)

films.syn: Cris, an elite runner, suffers a psychotic episode that forces her to step away from high-level competition. Not everyone around her will be able, or know how, to help, but Natalia, her sister, will become her safe space as she learns to accept her condition and redefine the pace of her life.

La Maestra and Paula are the best swimmers in their team and best friends, until an incident at a party changes everything. La Maestra, intense and unstoppable, realises that something in her best friend has changed, making her sad. When the truth comes to light, the two are faced with an impossible decision: Paula wants to keep quiet about it, while La Maestra wants revenge. Their friendship, previously unbreakable, will be put to the test as never before. ​

ap.sel: Officially selected (Horizontes Latinos - WIP Latam 2025, Proyecta 2022)

films.syn: While dealing with her mother’s impending death, Lali joins a gang of thieves dedicated to stealing religious artefacts. ​

Having escaped from jail, a dangerous criminal called Gustave Minda (Lino Ventura) seeks to reactivate his men, only to find himself caught up in a mass killing between rival bands. A police inspector closes in as he tries to organise a last heist and flee the country. First and last collaboration between two of the great architects of the French crime thriller genre, Giovanni –author of the novel and co-screenwriter– and Jean-Pierre Melville.

"At the end of 1935, Miguel Barga, my great-grandfather, left the family in Tolosa to return to the town of his birth in Burgos. Some time later, the family received word that Miguel had died in the war. His body was never returned. His death was taboo in the family for decades, until in 2018, the DNA programme run by the Gogora Institute identified his remains. By that time we had myriad details, but two important questions remained left unanswered. Why did he go and who killed him?". (Izaskun Arandia)

From 1985-1987, American journalist Edward Serotta visited Communist Romania and took photos of the country's harsh realities. The Secret Police (Securitate) followed him and secretly took photos of him taking photos. Forty years later, we put together the two sets of images, a shot/reverse shot revealing the comical side of history.

films.t: Six Months in a Pink & Blue Building
films.ot: Seis meses en el edificio rosa con azul
films.syn: Mexico City, early 90s. On the day of his 11th birthday, Bruno falls in love with his best friend Vladimir. That night his father receives an HIV-positive diagnosis that will change family life. Like in salsa songs, his family tries to sing and dance to keep the pain at bay. Thirty years later, Bruno films and revisits the memories he couldn’t quite fathom as a child.

ap.sel: Officially selected (Horizontes Latinos - Europe-Latin America Co-Production Forum 2022)

films.syn: In a thrilling gesture, Ingrid Caven and the Molforts band from Banyoles find themselves at a unique, cathartic and anarchic concert commemorating a whole life dedicated to art. Far from being a crepuscular recapitulation or the testament of a career, Seize moments de ma vie / Sixteen Moments of My Life celebrates avant-garde panache, creative drive and inspiration turning into an unrepeatable experience.

ap.sel: Officially selected (Made in Spain - Opening Film)

films.syn: It's the height of a radiant Danish summer. Mia arrives at her sister June's lakeside cabin, where June and her partner Jens are spending the season consumed by their IVF journey. What begins as a seemingly idyllic holiday soon becomes fraught with tension, as Mia carries news too heavy for casual conversation: she is pregnant, and has come to share this with June face to face. When the truth is finally revealed, the fragile hopes of June and Jens unravel.

An 11-year-old boy with unusual powers lives with his uncle in a Lebanese village where the noise of warplanes is part of everyday life. As his uncle tries to make him seem "normal," the boy secretly tests an ability he barely understands. When he accidentally causes two warplanes to crash, what was hidden becomes impossible to control.

films.ot: A veces me entra tristeza, otras veces rebelión
films.syn: Eva is on a short stay in Madrid. There she spends her days alone: she knows no-one, but neither is she particularly interested in making friends with strangers. The city is therefore a place she doesn't know, through which she wanders aimlessly and with her curiosity set to low. But one afternoon, in one of the rooms of the Reina Sofia Museum, a man approaches her. His name is Dante and he is an Argentinian historian in Madrid to carry out research into Juan Bialet Massé and the workers' struggles in his country.

films.t: Subijana: The Man Behind the Moustache
films.ot: Subijana, más allá de un bigote
films.syn: What lies beyond Pedro Subijana’s moustache? A personal and professional portrait of one of the pioneers of New Basque Cuisine: more than 50 years devoted to life and cooking, and a legacy that is now being passed on to new generations.

Wille dreams of being a superhero like his dad, but the arrival of his brother Charlie changes his life. When they discover that the baby has superpowers, the two will have to team up as a super duo against a dangerous villain.

Four wealthy men aim to increase their income by pooling their money in a huge narcotics deal. A fifth man (played by Giovanni himself) is tasked with bringing the shipment from Marseille. But things don't go to plan and they soon start fighting one another. This is the first of the productive collaborations between Giovanni and Jacques Deray, with the participation of Claude Sautet in the script.

When Tafiti, a young meerkat, meets Bristles the bush pig, he knows they can't be friends. But when Bristles is attacked by an eagle, it's Tafiti who runs to his rescue. Tafiti's grandfather is bitten by a deadly venomous snake. Only a mythical blue flower found in the desert can save him.
On their way to a remote vacation spot, a young couple witnesses a fatal hunting accident. Far from civilization and cut off from any help, they start to question the hunters' intentions.
You can even make Basque corn tortillas on a camping stove.

When Alzheimer’s begins to erase her mother’s personality, Sarah leaves her exciting life as an activist and artist in 90’s San Francisco to return to her eccentric family's conservative small town. Initially confident she can manage the situation, she soon realizes she must accept the harsh, disorienting reality of the disease to become the daughter her family needs.

films.t: Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma
films.syn: After years of slapdash sequels and waning fandom, the Camp Miasma slasher franchise is handed over to an enthusiastic young director for resurrection. But when she visits the star of the original film, now a reclusive actress shrouded in mystery, the two women fall into a blood-soaked world of desire, fear, and delirium.
Cannes Festival's Palme d'Or winner and Academy Award nominee Mike Leigh returns with his next feature film, continuing his insightful exploration of the contemporary world.

aw: Silver Shell for Best Leading Performance (ex aequo) (Kate O’Flynn)
Jury Prize for Best Screenplay (Mike Leigh)

films.syn: When 11-year-old Ruben’s father mysteriously disappears, the boy has to move in with his grandmother, a woman he barely knows. In a rural setting where time seems to have stood still, the child will learn that family wounds are passed down from one generation to another, and will try to find a way to heal them as he grows. ​

In a provincial Japanese town, Japanese-Russian siblings Nikita and Nina live an isolated life with their Russian grandparents, knowing their absent parents only through stories. When their father Nikolai suddenly returns, he takes them on a journey to see their mother Yuki, a Japanese ballet dancer. Along the way, the children discover unfamiliar landscapes, brief encounters, and the fragile bonds of family.

The acclaimed film director Esteban Martínez is a legend both for his films and for his past marked by violence and excess. For his new project, he offers his daughter Emilia a role under the pretext of helping her with her stalled acting career. Living together on set will foster a closeness they haven’t shared for years, but it will also reopen old wounds that never healed.

This time it was Claude Sautet who took to the screen another novel by Giovanni, who was starting to find himself in great demand in the cinema. Lino Ventura is Abel Davos, a criminal who succeeds in fleeing to Italy with his family, duping the police blockade. But after a skirmish at the border, the protagonist is left alone with his children. Based, with the name slightly changed, on a gangster who collaborated with the French Gestapo during the occupation.

Bizkaia, 1930. A harsh storm causes an English ship carrying tons of coal in its hold to run aground. During the night, the people of Algorta flock to the coast to rescue the black gold. Sabas Jauregui sees the occasion as a stroke of luck; Josefa, his wife, as a bad omen. Ignoring her pleas, Sabas drags his children towards the violent storm. The family will do the unthinkable to protect the coal that could save them from the winter... or condemn them forever.

ap.sel: Officially selected (Zinemira - Opening Film, 50 years of freedom)

films.syn: Gerardo Liesa is a young police inspector who has recently joined the UCRIF (the Central Unit for the Fight against Illegal Immigration Networks and Document Forgery). He and his colleague, Carmen Osés, sense that something is changing in brothels across Spain. Suizo and his associates run several brothels, sexually exploiting sex workers from all over the world. One of these women is Claudia. Aged 18, she has a young son in Colombia and has just arrived in Spain in search of a better future.

ap.sel: Officially selected (Official Selection - Not in competition)

films.syn: When Mona Friedman is cast in a bit part at a small community theater, she transforms from a shy, unassuming housewife into a zealous method actor willing to do anything to protect the artistic integrity of her marginal role—even if it means waging war against the show’s domineering director.

Graça lives in Belo Horizonte, where she gives private French lessons and lives with her French girlfriend. After a health emergency involving her father, she returns to her childhood home in the suburbs. There, a neighbouring family that leads a local religious congregation offers support. As they try to bring her back to "her place," Graça becomes trapped in a world of intolerance and fanaticism, setting her on a disturbing path toward the loss of sanity.

A group of young people meet to mull over and discuss democracy today. A brainstorming of ideas, intelligent reflections and dialectic confrontations. Words give way to bodies, tension turns into a game, the differences into a collective choreography that ends in revelry. They celebrate the diversity of being together, where democracy is no longer an abstract idea but becomes a shared, lively and entertaining experience.

ap.sel: Officially selected (Youth, cinema, memory and democracy - 50 years of freedom)

films.syn: After her parents’ separation, Carmela and her mother move into her grandmother’s home. As she struggles to adjust to her new reality, Carmela longs to spend more time at her father’s house. He is a visual artist whom she admires and idolizes. His lingering presence will lead the three generations of women in the family to decide the future they deserve.

West Germany, 1973. Iria and Hajo are in love. When Iria’s mother has a severe accident at the car factory where she works, Iria resolves to bring her back to the little village in the Galician mountains they both left many years ago. Hajo, eager to prove his solidarity, offers to drive. A road trip that begins as an act of hope soon begins to expose the rifts between the young couple. A film about power dynamics that connect the living with the dead, women with witches, and the past with the present.

In his second collaboration with Giovanni as an actor and producer, Alain Delon plays Hugo Sennart, a French gypsy wanted by the police for a string of crimes. Hugo is preparing what may be his last heist, but his plans cross with those of a jewel thief, wanted by the same police inspector as himself. Despite its fictional nature, the film proposes a documentary look at the gypsy camps and their way of life.

Álava, 19th century. Towards the end of the Third Carlist War, several women are found strangled to death on the outskirts of Vitoria. Ángela Berrosteguieta, sister of one of the victims, arrives seeking justice, determined to prove that Juan Díaz de Garayo, an illiterate farmer, is responsible for the crimes. Meanwhile, Pío Pinedo, head of the constabulary, must contend with the lack of resources in times of war and pressure from the authorities, who prefer to keep the rising wave of murders under wrap. ​

ap.sel: Officially selected (Official Selection - Special Screenings - Not in competition)
Officially selected (RTVE Gala; listed on the RTVE Gala section page, film card filed under Official Selection)
Officially selected (EITB Gala; listed on the EITB Gala section page, film card filed under Official Selection)

films.syn: In his posthumous film, Jacques Becker adapts the novel by Giovanni in which he narrated his attempted escape from La Santé prison. The writer ended up actively participating in the screenplay and providing all of the elements making for extreme realism. The four protagonists share a cell. When they are about to make their flight, they are assigned a fifth and subversive prisoner in the same, small space.

New York, 1964. A young journalist tracks down a potential Nazi officer living secretly in Queens. But when he befriends the lead suspect's charming wife, his investigation takes a disturbing turn. Based on a true story.

films.t: The Illusion of an Everlasting Summer
films.ot: La ilusión de un verano sin fin
films.syn: The documentary opens in 1999, when Sanguinetti invites her 9-year-old neighbours to share their fantasies, sparking a collaboration that lasts for decades. As Guillermina and Belinda leave childhood behind, their games take on the weight of reality. With the passage of time as its most palpable tension, the film becomes a record of their friendship as they move into work, motherhood and diverging paths. In the Argentinian Pampas, the film offers a female counterpoint to the region's male-dominated mythology.

Joe and Angela's marriage is on thin ice. When they invite their enigmatic neighbours, Pina and Hawk, round for dinner, a seemingly innocent evening gives way to confessions, hidden desires and situations that are as awkward as they are funny, putting their relationship to the test.

When you own a non-denominational funeral parlour. When you’ve lost your driver’s license for drinking too much. When you fall in love with an office trainee 25 years your junior. When your daughter begins to understand that you're not the father she thought you were. When the retired boxer who lent you money is on your back. When death seems more interesting than life… What could go wrong?

ap.sel: Officially selected (Official Selection - Special Screenings - Not in competition)

films.syn: Al Cook lives surrounded by memories. His apartment is packed with books, video tapes and vinyl records: remnants of a life that he once lived to the full. Here time seems to have stopped, while outside the world carries on without him. When his home is slated for demolition by a ruthless estate agency, they strip him of his refuge. As Al is forced to part with his treasures one by one, he asks himself a painful question: how do you move forward when memories are all you have left? Faced with total loss, he chooses a radical new beginning.
In the vibrant New York of the late 80s, Jimmy George, a famous underground artist, is experiencing a decisive moment in his life in which, despite everything, beauty and love are still possible.
Chile, 1992. While staying at her grandparents’ mountain hotel, Inés befriends Hanna, a German skier. When Hanna vanishes without trace, the search for her exposes hidden truths. ​

ap.sel: Officially selected (Horizontes Latinos - Proyecta 2022, 50 years of freedom)

films.syn: Maracuda ventures into a mysterious forest with Tink, a magical alien bird with uncontrollable powers. Between incredible creatures and fabulous adventures, they will discover the importance of friendship, responsibility and inner strength.

Two young women producers are tasked with making a documentary about an elusive and mysterious figure of the Argentinian vanguard in the 60s. The project also demands the participation of David Lamelas, a successful leading light of conceptual art and the artist's former travelling companion. What begins as a clear-cut, defined work set around interviews and archives starts to raise a worrying question: How can you lend visibility to a person who chose to disappear?

Nine members of a citizens' jury deliberate in isolation over a controversial corruption case. The evidence is irrefutable, public opinion is loud and clear, and no one seems to have any doubts… until they receive a secret offer: each juror will carry off a million euros if they change their vote from guilty to innocent. But if they want to play the game, they must reach unanimity, bringing to light the true burdens hanging over each of the jury members.

9-year-old Milo lives in a remote village in Argentina, where he trains as a malambo dancer. But his true dreams lie elsewhere: he longs to ride trains and explore Buenos Aires, the city he has only seen in movies. To break free from his small world, he must dare to embark on a new journey.

Memory gives us the basis on which to recognise ourselves, but how can we remember something that nobody talks about? Through archive footage, Isa Sáez talks to her grandmother about the taboos of their relationship.

A man jailed for murder is freed by members of the clan of a highly-respected Sicilian gangster. Together they plan to hijack a plane travelling to New York carrying precious gems, while the police rush to apprehend them. Adaptation of a novel by André Le Breton conceived as a major international production. It reunites the big three polar actors: Delon, Gabin and Ventura.

Seventeen-year-old Jin has never left the island where she was born—a place with no road to the mainland, where the sea quietly sets the rhythm of everyday life. When Dujae returns for his grandmother's funeral, he stays alone in the house she left behind. Jin begins finding small excuses to visit him, and little by little, seeing him becomes part of her everyday life. As summer wears on, the island she has always known begins to feel unfamiliar—the roads, the sea, the faces around her, all subtly transformed. Jin finds herself looking at it, and at herself, for the first time. But summer, like everything else on the island, will not stay.

United by an unbreakable friendship, Rafael and Carolina embark on an emotional and geographical journey in search of reconciliation and acceptance. Along the way, we follow Rafael through the early years of his gender transition: an intimate process, full of challenges, discoveries, and small victories that bring him closer to that square meter of peace he so deeply longs for. A light-filled story in which friendship becomes a refuge and the personal expands until it becomes universal.

ap.sel: Officially selected (Made in Spain - 50 years of freedom)

films.syn: Leo and Lorea have loved one another. Maybe they still do. But something in them has broken. After five years, their relationship is done. He looks after his sick father, trapped between responsibility and an emotional void that weighs him down. She, caught up in poorly-paid jobs and personal crises, tries to get her life back on track without really knowing where to begin. They are two bodies, tired and alone, crushed by their precarious situation, by unresolved issues, by the emotional legacy of a generation who always seem to come late to everything: to love, to stability, to maturity, to serenity, to personal satisfaction. ​

After what seemed like a trivial argument, Marta and Antonio split up. He, a rising chef, immerses himself in his work; she, in her silence, starts to feel something more than sadness: she has lost her appetite. When she discovers that the cause is a health problem, everything suddenly changes: food tastes better, she enjoys music like never before and desire sparks her enthusiasm to live without fear.

Immersion by Giovanni and Deray in spy stories. Lino Ventura is Paul Fabre, a French secret service officer sent to Vienna to find out if the Austrian head of French intelligence is in fact a double agent. Fabre is called up for the mission, trusting in his experience and instinct, and because he's one of the suspect's best friends.

For thirty years, Loran Bonnardot, a doctor from Paris, has been visiting Tristan da Cunha, the world's most remote inhabited island in the middle of the South Atlantic. Home to some of the most unique species, only 6 to 8 boats make the journey per year. This volcanic island has become Loran's spiritual refuge; its inhabitants, his chosen family, and Martin, the fisherman, his best friend. Now 50, Loran travels back to his utopian island once more but this time with no intention of leaving.

Construed as a protest against the death sentence, the film tells the tale of a criminal and his attempts to go straight as he returns to society on release from jail. He succeeds thanks to the help of a social worker; however, a series of events, added to the harassment of a cop who knows all about his past, drive him back into a life of crime. Produced by Alain Delon, who stars alongside Jean Gabin.

Nobody remembers their first school playtime. That day when the adults had gone. That day, I was in the playground. For eight years I filmed the same group of childen, asking myself: how do we grow under the gaze of others? How do we find our place in society? As the years pass, the playtime games gave way to role playing; the "You're not my friend any more" gave way to the "you can't play".

As they say in Getaria, “you must look people and fish in the eye”. Justo Silbeti (aged 91) needs the salt breeze to live; you can see the sea itself in his eyes. He started working at the age of 11, as a ship’s boy, and those memories remain vivid in his interior. Every morning he walks to the quay, but today isn’t just any old day; the special light in his eyes tell us that he still has something to do.

Everyone knows Karlos Arguiñano. He's been part of our lives for almost forty years, showing us how to cook from our TV screens while charming spectators. But, when it comes down to it: does everyone know him, or does everyone just think they do? This film shows Karlos in his most private spaces, but also in situations far removed from his routine, listening to the man himself and to those closest to him, looking for the person behind the personality.

films.t: Une robe noire pour un tueur
films.syn: In this film, Giovanni tells the tale of a falsely accused man, Simon Risler (Claude Brasseur), who escapes police custody after being tried and sentenced to death for a crime he didn't commit. He hides at the home of his defence lawyer (Annie Girardot), with whom he sets about proving his innocence and uncovering a corrupt plot involving high-ranking officers in the Financial Brigade of the French police force.

It's winter in the south of France when a young girl's frozen body is found in a ditch. She's filthy, a vagabond. Through flashbacks and brief interviews, we follow her last weeks, when she camps out alone or shacks up with a motley crew of men and women, many of whom lump their own needs onto her or try to influence the course of her life. Through other encounters, and the odd rejected offer of help, she pushes herself further into loneliness and silence.

A teacher, a writer and an orchestra conductor - three people, two couples - attend a fancy literary cocktail party. The writer has recently won the prize for his book Puente de Varsovia . The winner answers the journalist's questions one after the other, but is unable to come up with a synthesis of the plot of his book. They will simply have to read it. The next thing, the orchestra conductor's body decked out in scuba diving gear turns up in a burnt forest.

The Walker arrives in San Sebastián, a place of light-filled beauty. A red-coloured strip moves slowly through the forests and along the edges of the wind and the sea, between the noise of the night and the quietness of the day. With slow steps, he moves before the eyes of many: a calm figure in the immensity of the world, leaving a fleeting mark in the memory of strangers. Past and present merge with one another. Both creation and nature dissolve into dust​.

A poet breaks free from a life that has become suffocating to reconnect with her inner voice and conscience and allow her creativity to flow again. As she begins to question the conventions of family, identity and the meaning of life, her journey towards self-discovery challenges those around her to reconsider their own lives — taking the whole family in a new direction.

The film stars an actor generally associated to comedy, Rufus, who had formerly appeared in Un aller simple ( One Way Ticket ). This is a film of marked political overtones: working for a pacifist association dedicated to freeing political prisoners, Tom gradually realises that the non-violence in which he had always had faith doesn't work, pushing him to change sides and join the armed struggle.
A group of teenagers gathers for camping. While two of them try to define their romantic relationship, they are surprised by a swarm of fireflies that guides them into the heart of the forest.

On the day of a decisive court hearing and an important wedding performance, a quiet wedding musician finds his private life exposed to public scrutiny. Accused of exploiting his marriage, he moves between the courtroom, the city streets and the stage, carrying the weight of judgment, loyalty, and unspoken guilt. Forced to make a restrained but irreversible decision, the film observes a man whose inner truth remains elusive, caught between devotion, dignity and loss.

Shortly before the 1973 Chilean coup, CIA agents Chris and Lee set out to Easter Island from Santiago, where they are stationed alongside their boss and bureau chief, MJ. Amongst the Island's iconic statues, as the longtime partners wrestle with their dark pasts and present conspiracies, Chris's newfound bond with a pair of rebellious students threatens to send everyone’s trip to this remote paradise sideways.

films.t: Will You Still Be My Friend
films.syn: Amid an escalating feud in a rural Taiwanese village, a boy struggles to protect his secret friendship with his Singapore-raised best friend as adult conflicts threaten to tear them apart, while he quietly begins to question the true nature of his feelings for his friend.

films.ot: Winnipeg, el barco de la esperanza
films.syn: Víctor, a widowed father, and his small daughter Julia, leave Spain when Barcelona falls into the hands of Franco army in January 1939. In France they are met with concentration camps and destitution. But there is one possibility of escape: to set sail on the Winnipeg , a cargo ship chartered by Neruda and the Parisian Quakers, taking them to the safety of a new destination: Valparaíso, Chile, where a fresh start may await them.

1980. Thousands of women surround the Pentagon. They protest, weep, weave, create. They awaken another form of power and invent a new form of action. With Love and Rage is a political and musical incantation that brings this uprising back to life. The film weaves together archives, stories, voices, and songs, allowing a collective political voice - and the personal stories that make it up - to emerge.

For several weeks, 17-year-old Max has been living in a residential group for young people with mental disabilities. Visiting his father Peter's racehorse riding stable again for the first time, Max tries to convince him to accept his new life. Peter doesn't want to know anything about it and old patterns between the two break open again. Between insecurity and the desire for emotional closeness, Max begins to challenge his father.

At 18, Claudia doesn’t want to be the family heroine. Her mother’s illness erupts in their home like a silent storm. But Claudia only wants to live like any girl her age. Torn between family duty and the desire to enjoy her youth, Claudia will have to choose how to love without giving up on her own self.

directors.n: Nelson Carlo de los Santos Arias
